// Probe for the src/render/** layering rule. Committed as .txt so it is neither
// compiled nor linted where it lives; the check copies it into a layer and lints
// the copy:
//
//   cp test/fixtures/lint-probe.ts.txt src/render/__lint_probe.ts
//   npx eslint src/render/__lint_probe.ts   # must exit non-zero
//   cp test/fixtures/lint-probe.ts.txt src/github/__lint_probe.ts
//   npx eslint src/github/__lint_probe.ts   # must exit zero
//
// Copies are deleted afterwards and never committed. Keep this file otherwise
// lint-clean, so the only thing that can fail it is the layering rule.
import { context } from '@actions/github'

export function probeRepositoryName(): string {
  return context.repo.repo
}
